experiment_data.hypothesis: Full dev eval of r2a (1 epoch, alpha=128, clean data). Ablation: 1 epoch vs 3 epoch (r1). Pass: rel_f1 > 0.4057, evi_f1 > 0.798.
experiment_data.notes: RSFT r2a (1ep, alpha=128/r=64, lr=2e-5, clean 2548 samples). rel_f1=0.4494 (+0.0045 vs r1, +0.0001 vs r2b), evi_f1=0.8108 (-0.0079 vs r1, -0.0020 vs r2b), edcr=0.6641 (+0.0032 vs r2b). 1 epoch with clean data matches r1's 3-epoch rel_f1 while being cheaper. r2a vs r2b (alpha=128 vs 32): nearly identical rel_f1, marginal edcr advantage for higher alpha. All RSFT variants beat SFT baseline on rel_f1/evi_f1 but lose on edcr (0.66-0.66 vs 0.71).
